components.name: Bounded quotient-root future-action basis
components.project_addition: For the structured action family O_a(q)=R_r(floor(q/a)) on the bounded exact state domain 0,...,N, prove that an action set separates all exact states iff it contains every positive r-power-free integer b<=N. The proof derives the exact local jump law q=a*t^r, finite-descent power-free decomposition, forced boundary actions, and the unique least separating basis. This is a quotient-root specialization of generic distinguishing-test optimization using established power-free arithmetic, not a claim to invent Test Cover or power-free numbers.
